name: axonpush
description: axonpush agent observability and control skills. Zero instrumentation: change one base_url to route OpenAI or Anthropic traffic through the axonpush gateway, capture every call, tool call, and handoff as a span, and run inline moderation and spend policies. Also wires framework-native tracing (LangChain, CrewAI, Anthropic, OpenAI Agents, Vercel AI, Mastra, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Google ADK, OTel) when you want in-process events.
